observations.code_quote: 'Tool "read-data-warehouse-schema" was removed in favor of SQL-based schema discovery. Use "execute-sql" against `system.information_schema.*` (`tables`, `columns`, `relationships`, `data_types`) — it scales to large catalogs and supports filtering/search (e.g. `WHERE description ILIKE \'%...%\'`). Consult the `querying-posthog-data` skill (a built-in local skill, when installed) for patterns.',
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies that the SQL agent should not attempt to fetch the built-in skill from the team skills store, avoiding unnecessary 404s and feedback loops.

It is a built-in PostHog skill, not a team skill in the skills store, so do not fetch it with `skill-get`. When it is not installed, the `execute-sql` tool description carries the same core guidance.
